title: PageSpec
description: A page composition for the Northwind clone design system. Styling is owned by section/component contracts; a PageSpec carries no style or token-override field.

assetRoleSource.description: Required for protected roles (logos, people, screenshots): 'placeholder' = an explicit placeholder; 'supplied' = a real file the user provided. A generator may not fabricate either.

href.description: Relative path, #anchor or an example.com placeholder: generated pages must not link to the measured site's live URLs.

asset.description: Optional: a path from assets/asset-roles.json (relative to public/).
